_doc: runway.sc: the character studio's fashion show. floor = the studio floor box (music + titles go to real players inside).
runway: models walk along x from z_back (backstage) to z_front (the audience end) at feet y. The numbers are an example
room (the same one as residents.data.example and skinpaint.data.example); put your own runway's coordinates here.
join_button / start_button = vanilla button blocks you place (the app polls their powered state).
wardrobe.json = a copy of residents.data/wardrobe.json (the house show dresses mannequins from it when nobody signed up).
